svg.desc: Detail inside activation step 20. Units 01 current proofs and effects, 02 metadata-only key custody, 03 read acquisition, 04 completed-activation provenance, 05 fresh state observation and 06 signed plan with stateless owner are committed source. Units 07 consume-history custody, 08 durable plan retention and 09 root-admitted cold planner construction are source-landed in 658c59eabfffb8ed7f17525c9efbe16f527cfd34. Unit 10 cold planner launcher and private service is source-landed in d7336814d65d81ad070dbab1d55715f7e6ca2cd8. Unit 11 private consume authorization and issuance remains IN PROGRESS with 12 named substeps: 10 landed, 0 in progress and 2 open. A01–A03 foundations landed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8; A04–A08 first-exact storage, verified export, root-controlled key/storage delivery, cold planner connection and private export service landed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. A09 receiving-purpose key custody and A10 independent original-proof replay landed in b3c9a58472b788b8f06e3824cd57b6f345ecf6c2. NEXT within row 11: A11 actual consume-grant issuance and verification, then A12 cold consume-grant service. Units 12 reservation, 13 one-use SQL, 14 durable completion and recovery, 15 exact token release and 16 cold release handoff remain OPEN. Group c has 8/12 landed, 1 in progress and 3 other open; diagnostic groups remain 2/5, activation 19/26 and parents 34/46. All nested counts are nonadditive, not an effort percentage. No runtime or production claim. Source is uninstalled, unbuilt and unexecuted; production gates remain 0/6 verified.
